source.title: Computers and visualization in hyperbolic three-dimensional geometry and topology: Some open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/936891 with trailing identifier 936891. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as A. T. Fomenko, "Computers and visualization in hyperbolic three-dimensional geometry and topology: Some open problems", International Journal of Shape Modeling 1(1), pages 41-62, 1994, with DOI 10.1142/S0218654394000050.

Treated zbMATH as a bibliographic resolver. Direct shell fetches to zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, and api.crossref.org failed because the execution sandbox could not resolve external hosts. Hosted search confirmed the zbMATH/DBLP/Crossref/OpenAlex identity metadata and DOI, but did not expose a readable PDF or full HTML technical source.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact DOI plus PDF, DOI suffix, DBLP key, OpenAlex work identifier, and author/title variants. Candidate pages were rejected because they were metadata-only bibliographic pages, a EurekaMag purchase page offering full text by email for a fee, search snippets, related/citing works, or a Springer book chapter with different bibliographic identity rather than the exact 1994 journal article.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted, with local network_or_dns_failure for direct resolver/API fetching. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical open-problem statements was recovered, so the source adequacy, evidence coverage, and no-new-facts gates prevented extraction from metadata, abstracts, link labels, search snippets, or related works.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/936891.json and outputs/latest.json.
